headlines.title: 港交所行政总裁：正积极研究延长衍生产品的夜市交易时间
headlines.summary: 10月12日，香港交易所集团行政总裁陈翊庭发布新一期CEO网志。值得注意的是，陈翊庭本次发声信息量巨大，其中包括还将就优化特专科技公司和GEM上市制度展开咨询；吸引更多国际企业来港进行主要或第二上市；与内地合作伙伴正在进行将房地产信托基金（REIT）纳入沪深港通和人民币股票柜台纳入港股通的准备工作；正积极研究延长衍生产品的夜市交易时间，至于延长股票市场交易时间，香港交易所将从引领市场讨论开始，寻找市场各方都能接受的方案。（证券时报）

headlines.title_en: HKEX CEO: actively studying extension of after-hours derivatives trading
headlines.summary_en: On October 12, Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing CEO Bonnie Chan published a new CEO blog post. Notably, Chan's remarks carried a huge amount of information, including that consultations will be held on optimizing the listing regime for specialist technology companies and GEM; attracting more international companies to list in Hong Kong for primary or secondary listings; ongoing preparatory work with mainland partners to include REITs in Stock Connect and RMB stock counters in Southbound Stock Connect; and actively studying extending after-hours trading for derivatives, while for extending stock market trading hours, HKEX will start by leading market discussion to find a plan acceptable to all market parties. (Securities Times)

headlines.title: 叙利亚央行签发14年来首份信用证
headlines.summary: 叙利亚中央银行11日说，该行签发近14年来的首份信用证，为叙利亚石油公司与沙特阿美石油公司达成的石油产品供应协议提供便利。叙利亚央行说，这笔交易在一家美国主要银行的协调下完成。但叙方没有说明具体是哪家美国银行。信用证是银行根据开证申请人要求向受益人开立的有条件付款承诺，是国际贸易中最常用的结算方式之一。据悉，这笔交易标志着叙利亚在摘掉所谓“支持恐怖主义的国家”帽子和摆脱西方制裁后正重新接入国际金融体系。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: Syria's central bank issues first letter of credit in 14 years
headlines.summary_en: Syria's central bank said on the 11th that it had issued its first letter of credit in nearly 14 years, facilitating an oil product supply agreement between the Syrian Petroleum Company and Saudi Aramco. The Syrian central bank said the transaction was completed with coordination from a major US bank, but did not specify which US bank. A letter of credit is a conditional payment commitment issued by a bank at the request of the applicant in favor of the beneficiary, and is one of the most commonly used settlement methods in international trade. It is reported that this transaction marks Syria's re-entry into the international financial system after shedding the so-called "state sponsor of terrorism" label and emerging from Western sanctions. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: The Shenzhen Component Index and ChiNext Index both fell more than 1%, while Bank of China and ICBC hit new highs again. Hong Kong stocks rose then pulled back, with the Hang Seng Index up 0.2% at midday and the Hang Seng Tech Index down 0.6%; Xiaomi and Hua Hong Semiconductor fell more than 4%. Li Qiang will attend the opening ceremony of the 140th Canton Fair and related activities. The Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission issued the "Opinions on Strictly Investigating and Handling Illegal and Criminal Acts Endangering Food Safety in Accordance with the Law." Beijing police opened an investigation into companies related to CreditEase and took criminal coercive measures against the actual controller and others. Margin balances in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets decreased by 14.581 billion yuan last Friday. India's central bank took measures to defend the local currency, and the Indian rupee rose 1% against the US dollar.

headlines.title_en: Layout of low-risk, stable-return ETF products continues to accelerate
headlines.summary_en: In the week before the National Day holiday through the first trading day after the holiday, stock ETFs in the Shanghai market saw a total net inflow of 36.9 billion yuan, including 25.2 billion yuan into broad-based ETFs and 15 billion yuan into STAR 50 ETFs, reflecting recognition by various investors of the long-term allocation value of the equity market, especially the STAR Market. Recently, the launch of low-risk, stable-return ETF products has continued to accelerate. According to the CSRC website, before the holiday, multiple products were filed in a concentrated manner, including eight CSI Dividend Growth ETFs in the Shanghai market, further enriching the Shanghai market's diversified investment tool system. Market participants noted that in recent years, the Shanghai ETF market has continued to attract incremental capital inflows, with an increasingly rich product lineup and a continuously improving investment ecosystem, while market vitality and attractiveness keep rising, injecting lasting momentum into the stable and healthy development of the capital market. (CCTV News)

headlines.title_en: A-share close: ChiNext Index adjusts on lower volume, down 2.61%, over 4,300 stocks fall across market
headlines.summary_en: The three major A-share indices all fell today. At the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.43%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 2.03%, the ChiNext Index fell 2.61%, the BSE 50 fell 2.46%, and the STAR 50 Index fell 2.1%. Total market turnover was 1.5507 trillion yuan, down 365.9 billion yuan from the previous day, and more than 4,300 stocks in the whole market declined. By sector theme, AI video, wind power equipment, banks, gaming, complete vehicles, and securities led the gains; precious metals, grain concept, energy metals, oil and gas extraction and services, MLCC, and dairy led the declines. On the board, ByteDance's overseas short drama app PineDrama surpassed 100 million downloads, and the AI video direction remained active, with more than 10 stocks including Guomai Culture, Xinhua Du, and Longban Media hitting the daily limit. The banking sector fluctuated upward, with Bank of China, China Construction Bank, and ICBC hitting intraday new highs again.

headlines.title: 上海启动加快发展新一代智能制造行动，到2028年推动8000台人形机器人进工厂
headlines.summary: 10月12日，在第二十六届中国国际工业博览会开幕式上，“上海市加快发展新一代智能制造行动”正式启动。上海将实施四大工程、开展19项重点任务，推动人工智能与制造业深度融合，加快构建新一代智能制造体系。 目前，上海已培育2家国家领航级、28家国家卓越级智能工厂，数量多年位居全国城市第一，智能制造综合指数位居长三角城市榜首。上海智能制造系统集成产业规模超过600亿元，智能制造装备产值超过1500亿元，成为国内最大的智能制造系统集成和装备产业集聚区。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai launches action to accelerate development of next-generation smart manufacturing, aiming to bring 8,000 humanoid robots into factories by 2028
headlines.summary_en: On October 12, at the opening ceremony of the 26th China International Industry Fair, the "Shanghai Action to Accelerate the Development of a New Generation of Smart Manufacturing" was officially launched. Shanghai will implement four major projects and carry out 19 key tasks to promote deep integration of artificial intelligence and manufacturing and accelerate the building of a new-generation smart manufacturing system. At present, Shanghai has cultivated 2 national lighthouse-level and 28 national excellence-level smart factories, ranking first among Chinese cities for many years, and its comprehensive smart manufacturing index ranks first among Yangtze River Delta cities. Shanghai's smart manufacturing system integration industry scale exceeds 60 billion yuan, and smart manufacturing equipment output value exceeds 150 billion yuan, making it China's largest cluster for smart manufacturing system integration and equipment industry.

headlines.title: 崔东树谈欧盟插混“限制”：短期出口承压 但难撼动新能源车出口大盘
headlines.summary: 针对近期欧盟对中国车企插混车型出口“限制”一事，中国汽车流通协会乘联分会负责人崔东树表示，欧盟出台相关限制会给中国插混车出口带来一定影响，但国内插混产品竞争力强劲，已实现从电比油高到油电同价、再到电比油低的跨越，在技术、油耗、整车价值体验上全球领先。欧洲此前排斥插混路线，本土产业错失发展机遇，2025~2026年我国插混车出口在欧盟市场爆发，也因此带来竞争压力。（每经）

headlines.title_en: Cui Dongshu on EU plug-in hybrid 'restrictions': short-term export pressure, but unlikely to shake broader new energy vehicle export momentum
headlines.summary_en: Regarding the recent EU "restrictions" on exports of Chinese carmakers' plug-in hybrid models, Cui Dongshu, head of the China Passenger Car Association branch under the China Automobile Dealers Association, said the EU's related restrictions will have some impact on China's plug-in hybrid vehicle exports, but domestic plug-in hybrid products are highly competitive, having achieved a leap from electricity costing more than oil to oil-electric price parity and then to electricity costing less than oil, and are globally leading in technology, fuel consumption, and overall vehicle value experience. Europe previously rejected the plug-in hybrid route, causing its local industry to miss development opportunities. In 2025-2026, China's plug-in hybrid vehicle exports are expected to boom in the EU market, thereby bringing competitive pressure. (National Business Daily)

headlines.title_en: A-share close: ChiNext Index falls 2.61% on reduced volume; Kweichow Moutai reclaims the "stock king" crown
headlines.summary_en: The market fluctuated and adjusted throughout the day, with the ChiNext Index falling more than 2% in the afternoon. The banking sector strengthened against the trend, with Bank of China, ICBC, China Construction Bank, and CITIC Bank hitting new highs. Media and film stocks continued to strengthen, with Xinhua Media notching 10 consecutive limit-up days, while H&R Century, Bona Film Group, and Ciwen Media each recorded 2 consecutive limit-up days. Wind power and photovoltaic sectors surged during intraday trading, with Shouhang New Energy, Titan Wind Energy, and Tongda Power hitting the limit up. On the decline, computing power hardware stocks adjusted, with Jin'an Guoji and Huazheng New Material hitting the limit down. More stocks fell than rose, with over 4,300 stocks declining across the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, and today's turnover was 1.55 trillion yuan. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.43%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 2.03%, and the ChiNext Index fell 2.61%.
